create_questionnaire_component: create a Questionnaire component with questionnaires and player names to manage survey responses
reset_questionnaire: reset the Questionnaire component to clear all answers and answered masks for all players
check_questionnaire_done: check if a specific player or all players have completed all questionnaire questions
get_questionnaire_results: get aggregated questionnaire results as a DataFrame with players as rows and dimension scores as columns
plot_questionnaire_results: plot results for each questionnaire using the provided DataFrame and optional label column
